# Separate compose-only custom headers from explicitly expanded headers

initializeHeaderViewTables parses comma-separated mail.compose.other.header names, creates lower-case lookup keys and removes names also present in the space-separated extraExpandedHeaders preference from gCustomComposeHeaders. This gives explicitly expanded headers a broader display scope than compose-only headers. Keep case-insensitive comparisons and the two list formats separate when editing these prefs. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Message header preference classification.
